versions.description_html:
Learn how Azure Application Gateway handles Layer 7 load balancing, SSL termination, WAF security, routing rules, and autoscaling in plain English.

Most load balancers never read the request they're delivering. Azure Application Gateway does, and that single habit changes where your traffic lands.

In this episode of Simply Explained you will learn:
  • What It Actually Is
  • Listeners and Routing Rules
  • Backend Pools and Health Probes
  • Where HTTPS Gets Handled
  • What Stops the Attacks
  • Scaling Without Thinking
  • The Three Azure Load Balancers
  • Recap and a Question

Simply Explained by M365.FM breaks down Microsoft 365, Azure and modern IT topics in clear, jargon-free language. Hosted by Mirko Peters.

Explore more on M365.FM

  • Run Azure Application Gateway Without Public IP Exposure
